video.recommendation: Use as a click to play embed on a journal post about the Saturday market stall, and as a social clip. Do not autoplay, no sound by default, give a poster, lazy load, add captions. Not for the homepage hero (low resolution, ends with an end card).
video.caution: The end card says Every Saturday. That is a claim the client must confirm (which Saturday, which place) before it goes live.
